label: MATTER light · KNX
info: Native KNX integration: select an existing KNX Ultimate gateway and your Matter Controller/paired light endpoint. Replace the sample group addresses and verify their DPTs against ETS before Deploy. 1/1/1 on/off command, 1/1/2 state (DPT 1.001); 1/1/3 brightness command, 1/1/4 state (DPT 5.001). Commands and feedback use the KNX gateway directly: no Function node or intermediate wiring is required. Gateway selection is intentionally empty until you configure the example. Do not use this as a Topic-mode example.
